source_text: Incola ego sum apud te et peregrinus sicut omnes patres mei. Remitte mihi ut refrigerer priusquam abeam. Gloria Christo Iesu in saecula. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: I am a sojourner with you and a pilgrim like all my fathers. Forgive me that I may cool before I go. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[I am a sojourner with you, a pilgrim like all my fathers >> Bible:Psalm 39:12]]. [[Look away from me, that I may smile again before I depart >> Bible:Psalm 39:13]]. Glory to Christ Jesus forever. Amen.
